title: Should the Fouled Player Take the Penalty Himself?
excerpt: A player gets fouled by the GK and walks straight to the spot. Should he? Theory says no — jarred, agitated, while the keeper is locked in. A one-tailed z-test on 79 treatment penalties vs 3,456 controls in the top 5 European leagues.
finding: When the fouled player takes the penalty himself, conversion drops 3.0 pp (75.95% vs 78.96%) — but with only 79 such cases the data can't yet say 'hand it to someone else' (p = 0.26, one-tailed).
